_doc: What each day's build brought: the hover of the home dashboard's daily 120 km/h drive chart (dashboards.py bakes it into value mappings; regenerate and deploy after an edit). build = the commit that day's drive runs measure: the last release of the day (Europe/Berlin), before 09-21 the day's last commit, built in a detached worktree. Runs are labelled daily-<MMDD>-<n>, the stock game daily-stock-<n> (--prop enabled=false): harness/run.sh --mode drive --flag route=E:1200 --flag kmh=193 --flag zoom=max --prop instrument=true --prop uncappedFps=true --no-dashboard --launcher direct, from the worktree's own run.sh. excluded = runs whose drive telemetry (console 'harness: drive t=' lines) shows the car more than 10 tiles off the line (the pre-09-22 follower swings 7-9 at full speed without a hit) or a speed drop > 40 km/h: their fps is not the drive's.
